what_is_it.heading: Ukuvutha kwentliziyo kunye ne-reflux ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Isitshisa yimvakalelo etshisayo esifubeni okanye emqaleni ebangelwa sisisu esineasidi ebuyela ngasemva kumbhobho wokutya. Xa isenzeka rhoqo, ibizwa ngokuba yiGORD (gastro-oesophageal reflux disease).
paragraphs: Ivalve phakathi kwesisu kunye nombhobho wokutya wenzelwe ukuba uhlale uvaliwe. Xa iphumla rhoqo okanye ixesha elide, iasidi ibalekela phezulu. Isiphumo: Imvakalelo eshushu, etshisayo emva kwethambo lesifuba - rhoqo emva kokutya, kudla ngokuba nzima kakhulu ukulala phantsi.

Ukubetha kwentliziyo ngamaxesha athile emva kwesidlo esikhulu kuqhelekile. Isitshisa esenzeka kabini ngeveki nangaphezulu, okanye esikuvusayo ebusuku, sifanelwe kukuqwalaselwa. Ingonakalisa umbhobho wokutya kwiminyaka. Iindaba ezimnandi: utshintsho lwendlela yokuphila kunye namayeza alula asebenza kakuhle kubantu abaninzi.

items.headline: 1 ku4
items.body: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bafumana isitshisa kanye ngeveki. Baninzi kakhulu ngamanye amaxesha. Ixhaphake kakhulu.

items.headline: Iyanyangeka
items.body: Ukutshintsha kwendlela yokuphila kunye neyeza elilula (iiPPIs ezifana ne-omeprazole) zisebenza kakuhle kakhulu. Uninzi lwabantu lufumana isiqabu esikhulu kwiiveki ezi-2.

items.headline: Unokulinganisa intliziyo
items.body: Isitshisa esinzima sinokuziva sifana nokuhlaselwa kwentliziyo. Ukuba awuqinisekanga — ngakumbi ukuba unomsi, ukuphefumla kunzima, ubuhlungu kwisihlathi okanye ehlombe — cinga ngentliziyo kwaye utsalele umnxeba ku-10177.

items.headline: Jonga iiflegi ezibomvu
items.body: Ubunzima bokuginya, ukwehla kobunzima bomzimba, ukugabha igazi, ilindle elimnyama — ezi ayisiso isitshisa. Bonana nogqirha ngaphandle kokulibazisa.

pull_quote.text: Ukuba uthatha amayeza esitshisa yonke imihla ngaphezu kweeveki ezimbalwa, fumana uvavanyo olululo. I-acid reflux yexesha elide inokonakalisa umbhobho wokutya kwaye ayifane ikhokelele kumhlaza - zombini zinokuthintelwa ngokhathalelo olufanelekileyo.

signs.heading: Yintoni omawuyijonge
signs.lede: Isitshisa sinepateni eqhelekileyo - kodwa ezinye iimpawu zilumkisa ngento enzulu ngakumbi.

items.title: Isitshisa esiqhelekileyo
items.description: Ukutshisa emva kwethambo lesifuba, rhoqo emva kokutya. Incasa emuncu okanye ekrakra emva komqala. Okubi kakhulu ukulala phantsi, ukugoba, okanye emva kokutya okukhulu okanye okunamafutha. Isiqabu kwii-antacids.

items.title: Iimpawu zeReflux
items.description: Iasidi ingena emqaleni okanye emlonyeni, ngakumbi ebusuku. Ukukhohlela okuzingileyo okanye ukurhawuzelelwa. Ngamanye amaxesha ukubetha okanye iimpawu ezifana ne-asthma. Okubi ngakumbi ngokufumana ubunzima okanye ukukhulelwa.

items.title: Iiflegi ezibomvu - bonana nogqirha
items.description: Ubunzima okanye obubuhlungu bokuginya, ukutya okuncamathelayo, ukwehla kobunzima bomzimba, ukugabha igazi, ilindle elimnyama, iintlungu ezibuhlungu zesifuba—ukuhlaselwa yintliziyo. Akukho nanye kwezi 'sisitshisa nje'.

items.fact: Ubisi luthintela iasidi ngokufutshane, emva koko lwenza izinto zibe mbi ngakumbi - amanqatha obisi abangela ukukhutshwa kweasidi ngaphezulu. Sebenzisa ii-antacids ezenzelwe umsebenzi (umzekelo, i-Gaviscon).

items.myth: I-Reflux kukungonwabi nje - ayibangeli monakalo wokwenyani.
items.fact: Iminyaka ye-reflux enganyangwayo inokonakalisa umbhobho wokutya (i-esophagitis), ibangele ukucutheka, kwaye kunqabile ukuba ikhokelele kwimeko yomhlaza. Kufanelekile ukunyangwa, kungekhona nje ukunyamezela.

items.myth: Isitshisa sihlala emva kokutya ukutya okuneziqholo.
items.fact: Izinto ezibangela okuqhelekileyo ziyahluka: ikofu, ukutya okunamafutha, itshokolethi, utywala, i-peppermint, i-citrus, izidlo ezinkulu, ukutya kade. Abantu abahlukeneyo baneziphembeleli ezahlukeneyo. Idayari yokutya iyanceda.

items.myth: Ukuba ndinciphisa umzimba, isitshisa siya kuhamba ngomlingo.
items.fact: Ukwehla kobunzima kunceda kakhulu, ngakumbi apha esinqeni. Kodwa abantu abaninzi ababhityileyo bane-reflux nabo-kwaye ubunzima ayisiyiyo kuphela into. Hlanganisa ukulawula ubunzima kunye nolunye utshintsho.

prevention.heading: Imikhwa yemihla ngemihla eluncedo
prevention.lede: Iinguqu kwindlela yokuphila zihlala zinamandla ngakumbi kunamayeza e-reflux ephakathi ukuya kwephakathi. Kufanelekile ukuzama iiveki ze-4 ngaphambi kokuhlala kwiipilisi ngonaphakade.

items.title: Ukutya okuncinci, yitya kancinci
items.description: Izidlo ezinkulu zizalise isisu kwaye zityhala iasidi phezulu. Zama iinxalenye ezincinci, yitya kancinci, ungabuyi umva imizuzwana ngexesha elinye.

items.title: Ungatyi kwiiyure ezi-3 zokulala
items.description: Ukulala ngesisu esigcweleyo kuyindlela yokwenza i-reflux ebusuku. Isidlo sokugqibela ubuncinane kwiiyure ezi-3 ngaphambi kokulala. I-snack elula kuphela xa kuyimfuneko.

items.title: Aphakamise intloko yebhedi
items.description: Beka iibhloko ze-10-15cm phantsi kwemilenze ye-headboard (kungekhona nje imithwalo eyongezelelweyo - ezi zigoba intamo). Umxhuzulane ugcina iasidi phantsi ebusuku.

items.title: Sika izichukumisi zakho
items.description: Okuqhelekileyo: ikofu, utywala, ukutya okunamafutha, itshokolethi, i-peppermint, i-citrus, ukutya okuneziqholo, ukutshaya, ukubopha ezinqeni eziqinileyo. Yeka ukutshaya ngokupheleleyo - yenza buthathaka ivalve ngokuthe ngqo.

items.title: Zama ukutshintsha indlela yokuphila kwiiveki ezi-4
items.description: Ukutya okuncinci, akukho ukutya kade, ibhedi ephakanyisiweyo, chonga izinto ezibangela. Malunga nesiqingatha sabantu sifumana isiqabu esikhulu kwezi zodwa - akukho mayeza afunekayo.

items.title: Zama ii-antacids ezithengiswayo ngamaxesha athile
items.description: Gaviscon, Rennies, okanye umsebenzi ofanayo ngokukhawuleza kwiziqendu ngamaxesha. Ifumaneka nakweyiphi na ikhemesti. Musa ukuzisebenzisa yonke imihla - olo luphawu ukuba ufuna indlela eyahlukileyo.

items.title: Ukuba iimpawu ze-2 + ngeveki - jonga iklinikhi
items.description: IiPPIs (omeprazole, esomeprazole) ezisetyenziswa kwiiveki ezi-4-8 zihlala zisebenza kakhulu. Zisimahla kwiikliniki zikarhulumente. Musa ukuwathatha ngonaphakade ngaphandle kokuhlolwa kwezonyango.

items.title: Ukuba iiflegi ezibomvu zivela - hamba ngaphandle kokulibazisa
items.description: Ubunzima bokugwinya, ukunciphisa umzimba, ukuhlanza igazi, izitulo ezimnyama - ezi zifuna ukuxilongwa ngokukhawuleza, ngamanye amaxesha i-endoscopy. Sukuzama unyango olufumaneka ngaphandle kwekhawuntara kwezi.

items.title: Ukuba ubuhlungu besifuba - cinga intliziyo kuqala
items.description: Ukuhlaselwa kwentliziyo kunye nesitshisa sinokuziva sifana. Ukuba unomsi, ukuphefumla kunzima, ubuhlungu kwisihlathi okanye ehlombe, okanye awuqinisekanga — tsalela umnxeba ku-10177. Kukhethekile ukuba uphephe.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Uninzi lwe-reflux lunokulawulwa kwinqanaba lekliniki. Iimpawu eziqhubekayo okanye iiflegi ezibomvu zizuza ngokuthunyelwa kweengcali.

helplines.name: I-ambulensi kaxakeka
helplines.description: Ukuba intlungu yesifuba inokuba sisifo sentliziyo

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Uvavanyo lwasimahla, iingcebiso ngendlela yokuphila, kunye nonyango olubhalwe ngugqirha
helplines.meta: Akukho kuqeshwa · akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo

helplines.name: Nayiphi na ikhemesti yendawo
helplines.description: Ii-antacids ezifumaneka kwi-counter-counter ukuze zisetyenziswe ngamaxesha athile
